description:
In crates/imap/src/session/mod.rs, the AUTHENTICATE command dispatch increments auth_failures on any None return from the auth handler, including AuthenticateData::Cancel (the client sends '*'). This conflates a clean client-initiated abort of an authentication exchange with a failed credential attempt. A client that attempts AUTHENTICATE PLAIN and then cancels the exchange three times receives a forced BYE disconnect as if it had supplied three wrong passwords.

RFC 9051 §9.1 specifies that a client may cancel an authentication exchange with a '*' response and the server MUST return a BAD tagged response; it does not permit treating a cancel as a failed authentication for lockout purposes.

Trigger: connect to the IMAP server and send AUTHENTICATE PLAIN followed by '*' three times without ever sending bad credentials.

Fix: distinguish cancel returns from credential-failure returns in the auth handler result type (e.g. use a three-variant enum: Success, Failure, Cancel) and only increment auth_failures on Failure, not Cancel.
title: imap: AUTH CANCEL increments auth_failures → premature BYE
